Definition: a peg (as bristling from the surface)
BiblicalUsage: Masmer is the nail, the peg, and it fastens things that should not move. 1 Chronicles 22:3 has David preparing iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, while Jeremiah 10:4 turns the word against idols, decked with silver and gold and fastened with nails and hammers, that they move not.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the nail in Jeremiah 10:4 is the giveaway: a god that has to be nailed down is no god at all.
